newsitem.title: EU: EP Budgetary Control Committee agenda - July 21-22.
newsitem.headline: EP Budgetary Control Committee agenda - July 21-22.

text.p: ===] Monday 21 July at 3 p.m. 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE223.148 ) 2. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 7 April 1997 in Strasbourg (PE221.922 ) - 1 and 2 July 1997 in Luxembourg (PE223.147 ) 3. Chairman's announcements 4. Decisions on procedure 4.1 Future financing of the European Union (Agenda 2000) (T05142) F BUDG Fond R COLOM I N. (PSE) 4.2 Opinion for the Committee on Institutional Affairs on the Amsterdam Treaty 4.3 Opinion for the Committee on Budgets on Agenda 2000 4.4 A Union policy against corruption (communication) (T05530) COS0571 COM(97)0192 C4-0273/97 + CONT Avis F LIBE Fond R BONTEMPI Rinaldo. (PSE) 4.5 Opinion for the Committee on Civil Liberties on judicial cooperation in criminal matters in Europe 4.6 5. 1996 annual report and 1997-98 work programme: protection of the Community's financial interests and combating fraud (T05144) COS0560 COM(97)0200 C4-0230/97 + CONT Fond R BOSCH Herbert. (PSE) (PE222.169 ) - Exchange of views Exchange of views on the basis of a draft report 6. Implementation of the 1997 budget - other sections - Rapporteur: J.M. FABRA VALLES 6.1 Proposal for transfer of appropriations no 32/97 - Court of Auditors 6.2 Proposal for a transfer of appropriations: EP - Am. 1 - Ombudsman 6.3 Request for transfer of appropriations C4 - Parliament (consequences of the Court of Justice judgment in the De Compte case) (PE222.177 ) 7. Decision to overrule the Financial Controller of the European Parliament on a call for tender - Member responsible: John TOMLINSON - Exchange of views 8. Transit action programme - Exchange of views Exchange of views on the basis of a working document by Mr KELLETT-BOWMAN and TOMLINSON (PE223.145 ) 8.1 * * * ===] Tuesday 22 July at 9 a.m. ===] In the presence of Mr PAPOUTSIS, Member of the Commission 9. Special report 3/96 of the Court of Auditors on tourist policy and the promotion of tourism (T05393) COS0522 C4-050/97 C4-0050/97 + CONT Fond R DE LUCA S. (UPE) (PE222.172 ) - Exchange of views Exchange of views on the basis of a draft report 10. The powers and obligations of agents authorized by the Commission (Article 18(2) and (3), Regulation No 1552/89) (T05375) CNS97016 COM(96)0717 C4-0067/97 + CONT Fond R BARDONG Otto. (PPE) (PE222.173 ) - Adoption of draft report 11. Monitoring of the implementation of the current budget - utilization of appropriations - Member responsible: L.J. BRINKHORST - Exchange of views Exchange of views on the basis of a notice to members (PE223.150 ) 12. Implementation of the 1997 budget - Section III - Commission - Rapporteur: L.J. BRINKHORST 12.1 (GBD3097 ) Proposal for transfer No 30/97 - EAGGF Guarantee 12.2 (GBD3197 ) Proposal for transfer no 31/97 - audiovisual equipment 13. Management of appropriations for the democracy programme (PHARE and TACIS) - Members responsible: Mrs HOFF, Mrs KJER HANSEN and Mrs MULLER - Exchange of views 14. Any other business 15. Date of next meeting (PE/XVI/OJ/97-19 ) - and joint meeting with the Committee on Development on 3 September, 4.30 - 6.30 p.m. - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
